summary: This video is a giveaway announcement hosted by Gorax and sponsored by BuffBuff. Forty winners will receive 350 Dragon Crystals each in their in-game mail. To enter, viewers must subscribe, like the video, and comment with their favorite Season 9 hero and who they plan to summon. Entries are accepted until October 24th at 7:00 AM London time. The creator also promotes discounted Dragonair packs on BuffBuff using their creator code.
